summary.text: Jack Geiger is an independent candidate for Kansas House of Representatives District 62 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Republican Sean Willcott.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a sixth-generation Kansas farmer and listed fair and transparent taxation among his key messages.

paragraphs.text: Jack Geiger graduated from Sacred Heart High School and earned a bachelor's degree from Kansas State University in 1993, and Ballotpedia lists his career experience as farming and ranching.
In his survey responses he said he holds a Bachelor of Science in Agronomy and Natural Resource Management from Kansas State with a minor in political science.

He said he has served on the Kansas Executive Beef Council, as OCIA International president and on the Cattlemen's Beef Board, and locally as a township trustee and as president of Rose Hill Cemetery District 9.
He said he and his wife, Deborah, raised their three children on their farm in Robinson, Kansas.
Geiger listed fiscal responsibility, empowering local people and fair and transparent taxation as his key campaign messages.
He said property tax should be transparent and uniform while respecting retirees on fixed incomes, and named taxation and rural economic development as the policy areas he cares most about.
